verdict.why_not_reviewable: Five load-bearing topics remain unresolved: sampling, the attempted frame, missingness, retry and vantage, with port-window coverage partial beside them. A human reviewer could not complete the five-field reliability review on this basis, and sampling alone decides whether the count is comparable with any other apparatus.
verdict.why_not_NOT_REVIEWABLE: Nothing retrieved contradicts reviewability. Each remaining question is answerable by the provider in a sentence, and six of the seven frozen enquiry questions target exactly these topics.
